notes.title: v 1.1.0 - Joystick support and new price
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
we're releasing an update that includes partial joystick support.
Also, due to the extremely low number of sales, we are lowering the price of the game. We hope this new value will attract more people!
[b]We thank all the players who bought the game at the original price, being only 7 players, we did not think that the value of $ 1.99 was considered too high, due to the fact that it is a complete game with history, sounds, music and art all made by us, but apparently this value is considered too high.[/b]
